Documentation per shipment: COA, MSDS (16-language), INCI disclosure, allergen declaration, animal-testing statement, Certificate of Free Sale.

mainEntity.name: How large is your R&D team and what are their qualifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: 8 in-house chemists (5 MSc, 3 BSc) plus 2 regulatory specialists. Two of our chemists hold PhDs in cosmetic science from South China University of Technology. We maintain joint laboratories with SCUT and Guangdong University of Technology for advanced formulation work.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical formulation development timeline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stock ODM SKU customization (color, fragrance, viscosity tweaks): 15-25 days for orders under 20,000 units. Full custom OEM formulation and a lab sample: 30-45 days. Stability and compatibility testing is a scheduled programme that runs in months and is quoted separately. Lab samples ship within 7-10 days of brief confirmation.

mainEntity.name: What QC tests do you run on every batch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Six-step QC: IQC (raw material), batching (active ingredient verification), IPQC (in-process pH/viscosity/density), filling (weight check at start, middle, end of run), OQC (final product COA vs spec), third-party verification (SGS / Intertek for export batches). 1.2% batch reject rate YTD 2026.

mainEntity.name: What documentation is provided per shipment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Per-shipment package: COA (batch-specific), MSDS (16-language), INCI disclosure, allergen declaration, animal-testing statement, Certificate of Free Sale, and chain-of-custody log. All documents are digitally signed and archived for 10 years.

mainEntity.name: Can I visit the factory for an audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Factory audits are welcomed with 7 days notice. We host 30-40 buyer audits per year. On-site: GMP walkthrough, lab visit, QC station demo, batch record review, and management interview. Remote video audits are available via WeChat / Zoom on request.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with third-party testing labs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We have standing partnerships with SGS (Guangzhou), Intertek (Shenzhen), and Pony Testing (Beijing) for export certification. For US market, we use AMA Labs (New Hampshire) and Eurofins (USA). Testing costs for buyer-required additional tests are quoted separately and not bundled in MOQ pricing.

content.title: In-house R&D with joint university laboratories, on-site QC lab, and a 6-step process that ships only what we can defend
content.lead: Every claim on this site is backed by a registered IP, a documented process, and a third-party lab report. Our technical team develops every formula — and we let you audit every step of how it gets to your customer.

content.title: In-house R&D, with joint laboratories at two universities
content.html:
Technical team

In-house R&D, backed by university partnerships

Our in-house technical team is responsible for every formula on this site — from the bio-enzyme + probiotic deodorizing complex to the stabilized chlorine dioxide disinfectant system. We don't white-label third-party formulas and we don't pass through generic bases.

In addition to our internal team, we maintain active R&D cooperation with partner universities in formulation chemistry, microbiology, and packaging engineering. This gives us access to academic literature, validation methods, and a pipeline of graduate-level researchers for the custom formula projects that go beyond catalog.

In-house technical team University R&D partnerships Microbiology lab Formulation chemistry Custom formula development

content.title: What we measure in-house, before we ship
content.html:
Lab capabilities

What we measure in-house, before we ship

Our on-site lab handles routine QC. For final claim verification (kill rates, allergen removal, probiotic counts) we use independent third-party labs — reports published in full.

pH & conductivity

Every batch. Calibrated daily. Recorded in the batch ledger.

Microbial limits

Total plate count, yeast & mold, E. coli, S. aureus, P. aeruginosa — per pharmacopeia.

Active content

Chlorine dioxide concentration, enzyme activity, probiotic CFU counts.

Stability & aging

Accelerated aging at 40 °C / 75% RH. Long-term shelf-life validation for new SKUs.

cards.num: 1 IQC · Incoming Quality Control Every raw material lot is sampled on arrival. COA from supplier is verified against in-house re-test for identity, purity, and microbial load. Non-conforming lots are rejected and isolated. REJECT-RATE TRACKED
cards.title: IQC · Incoming Quality Control

cards.num: 2 Formula batching Mixing & blending under validated process parameters: temperature, RPM, vacuum, hold time. Batch records captured digitally and counter-signed by the line supervisor. DIGITAL BATCH RECORD
cards.title: Formula batching

cards.num: 3 IPQC · In-Process Quality Control pH, viscosity, active content, and visual checks at pre-defined checkpoints. Out-of-spec batches are quarantined before filling — not after. CHECKPOINT-LEVEL
cards.title: IPQC · In-Process Quality Control

cards.num: 4 Filling & packaging Class-D cleanroom filling with online particle counting. Fill-weight verification, torque testing on caps, leak detection, and visual inspection on every unit. UNIT-LEVEL TRACE
cards.title: Filling & packaging

cards.num: 5 OQC · Outgoing Quality Control Final sampling per AQL. Microbial limits, active content, appearance, pH, and packaging integrity. Only lots that pass every OQC check are released to the warehouse. AQL SAMPLING
cards.title: OQC · Outgoing Quality Control

cards.num: 6 3rd-party claim verification For every claim published on this site (94.2% ammonia removal, 99.999% kill rate, etc.) we commission an independent lab. Reports are public and PDF-downloadable. INDEPENDENT LAB
cards.title: 3rd-party claim verification

content.title: Your formula, our lab — under NDA, on a documented timeline
content.html:
Custom development

Your formula, our lab — under NDA, on a documented timeline

For OEM projects, our R&D team starts from your spec — target performance, ingredient preferences, regulatory targets, and target cost. We sign a mutual NDA before any formula or spec exchange.

Typical OEM project: 30–45 days from spec acceptance to lab sample, then another 25–40 days for pilot batch and stability. Your formula, your IP — we sign an IP assignment at project kickoff.

  • ✓ NDA signed before any spec exchange
  • ✓ IP assignment at project kickoff — formula belongs to you
  • ✓ Stability data provided before commercial order
  • ✓ Compliance hand-off for FDA, EU, and target-market filings
